protocol.hypothesis: With identical source cases, encoder features, global-necessity loss, positive span loss, architecture, initialization, and project exclusions, compare defaulted negative intents against observed-only intent masks.
protocol.model: Frozen ModernBERT cached complete target/context features; token MLP 1536 to 64 GELU to 9 logits
protocol.intent_loss_reduction: Mean across observed dimensions; empty mask skips this loss
protocol.delivery_score: Minimum of pooled unit-global necessity logit and selected token intent logit; same cutoff for both scores; calibration uses the identical unit-envelope score
protocol.calibration: Exclude the test source group; both known global necessity classes, at least ten selected known cases and 85 percent proxy precision; maximize true positives, then minimize false positives, then higher cutoff
protocol.delivery: At most two available purposes per unit, at most eight contiguous original-byte runs per purpose, protected ranges excluded; the pooled unit-global necessity score gates every token intent span; no rewrite or probability
protocol.inference_input: Complete raw source target and adjacent original units already bound to cached features; no reason, annotation identity, label, or evaluation judgment
protocol.failure_policy: One bounded offline run, no automatic retry; retain errors and every original event. New predictions do not modify the old experiment or evaluation labels.
limitations: Both arms use a new global-necessity head; this does not isolate its effect against the older eight-output study.
Only intent supervision differs within this matched comparison.
The source pool is exposed development, not prospective confirmation.
Structural span witnesses are not semantic FULL or usefulness.

completed_training.limits: Structural byte coverage and intent agreement are not semantic FULL or actual criticism usefulness. No runtime or gate change.

independent_audit.limitation: Complete byte-component union is only an optimistic localization bound; purpose and semantic review remain required.
